chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: The Follies' payoff and tightening the act
summary: On Tape 6 the Follies made them more marketable; the act stayed the same but tighter.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: You were about to recall if you could that bit.

That bit would be with E.C. I couldn't think what it would be just to save my soul. That's hard for me to that's hard for me to think of, man. That's so far back. E. C. he come there, that's all I can remember. He come there. No, I can't think of that bit. Don't strike me at all.
Now, where do I go from there.
But the Ziegfeld Follies were a great success for you.
In terms of making you more marketable?
Was your act any different at the Ziegfeld Follies than it had been?
uh-uh. Just tightened, tightened it up.
